• P1 Foundation (weeks 1–6): micro-frontend shell with navigation, routing and the Client design system, Azure AD/MSAL authentication, and E2E, pipeline quality-gate, security and authentication negative-test automation.
• P2a Services and Data (weeks 7–16): FastAPI faceted search/detail endpoints, asynchronous long-query processing, OneGWAS direct-write integration, and a performance engineering spike.
• P2a test automation: backend integration and load tests, OneGWAS E2E/failure-retry tests, and validation scripts for Client-built data ingestion, migration, extraction and taxonomy.
• P2b Application Surface (weeks 17–21): ARC micro-frontend faceted search, result detail view, PHG/GATSBY interval visualization, haplotype filter and comparison, and haplotype API endpoints.
• P2b nomenclature service: trait resolution, synonym lookup, unmapped-term handling and ARC backend integration, with frontend, backend, nomenclature and haplotype test suites.
• P3 Launch (weeks 22–26): integration, performance, security and cross-browser (Chrome, Edge) test suites at production-like volume, plus test data and fixtures.
• P3 Launch execution: UAT cycles with defect triage and tracking, pre-launch hardening iteration with full regression, and production smoke tests with a 48-hour defect watch.
• MTA Store parity and zero-legacy-traffic confirmation report, plus training materials and user documentation.
